rulings.restated: Enter the amount from f1040 line 7a.
rulings.model: Line 5a is "Net gain or loss from disposition of property (see instructions)," while f1040 line 7a is "Capital gain or (loss)." The line 5a instructions are not in the pages given, so whether 7a alone is the right source cannot be confirmed.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The dispositions of property in net investment income within the slice are the securities sales and capital gain distributions Schedule D carries to Form 1040 line 7a; every other disposition or adjustment (i8960 p. 9, line 5a) is refused by `f8960.unsupported` ("Any annuity, rental, royalty, business/pass-through income, CFC/PFIC holding, section 911 exclusion, disposition adjustment, NOL or other NIIT modification outside this slice?"). No change to the data.

rulings.restated: Choose — [sa helper "Itemize if elected, required, or itemized total exceeds standard" = true → helper "Deductible state/local income and property taxes reasonably allocated to net investment income; exclude foreign taxes for which a credit is claimed"] [sa helper "Itemize if elected, required, or itemized total exceeds standard" = false → helper "Year parameter sales.zero"]
rulings.model: The instructions say "Include state, local, and foreign income taxes you paid for the tax year that are attributable to NII" and "foreign real property taxes," barring only foreign taxes for which a credit was taken. The helper covers state/local taxes only and is capped at sa line 5e, which leaves out uncredited foreign taxes, and no refusal names that case.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. The instructions include "state, local, and foreign income taxes" and "foreign real property taxes" except those for which a credit was taken (i8960 p. 17, line 9b). In this slice no foreign tax is ever deducted: Schedule A line 5a takes state and local income taxes only, line 6 is zero behind the screen that names the foreign tax deduction, and foreign taxes paid are credited through the Schedule 3 line 1 election or refused (`ftc.needs1116`). The deductible taxes allocable to net investment income are therefore state and local, as encoded. No change to the data.
